coverage.p0_finding: Resource-aware authorization must evaluate full governed resource context and fail closed on missing context
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Authorization decision proven to evaluate full resource context and deny on missing context in a real environment
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of fail-closed denial under missing or ambiguous authorization context

coverage.p0_finding: A review decision must require an assigned reviewer with reviewer scope and correct jurisdiction
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Review command proven to require reviewer scope and jurisdiction before acceptance
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of rejection when reviewer scope or jurisdiction is absent

coverage.p0_finding: Governed evidence must be bound to its case and protected under restricted-evidence controls
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Evidence proven bound to its case and access-controlled as restricted in a real environment
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of restricted-evidence access enforcement

coverage.p0_finding: Every production dependency required for a governed decision must be present and verified before the decision is trusted
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Governed decisions proven to fail closed on any missing production dependency
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of dependency verification before trusted decisions

coverage.p0_finding: Every affiliation lifecycle transition must be authorized through the governance kernel and never mutate governed state directly
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Transitions proven to flow through the kernel with no direct state mutation path
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence that no domain path mutates governed state outside the kernel

coverage.p0_finding: Every governed decision must resolve to a versioned policy and protect the integrity of that requirement
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Decisions proven to resolve to a versioned policy with protected integrity
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of version resolution and integrity protection

coverage.p0_finding: Every return and resubmission must be recorded as immutable history
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Return and resubmission proven recorded as immutable, append-only history
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of immutable return and resubmission history

coverage.p0_finding: Authoritative activation must be unique and protected against replay
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Activation proven unique and replay-protected in a real environment
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of replay rejection and single authoritative activation

coverage.p0_finding: Missing or invalid governed configuration must fail closed
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: System proven to fail closed on missing or invalid governed configuration
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of fail-closed behaviour on configuration defects

coverage.p0_finding: The transactional outbox must be protected and its publication evidenced
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Outbox proven protected with evidenced publication in a real environment
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of outbox integrity and publication evidence

coverage.p0_finding: Governed data behaviour must be verified against the real data platform, not assumed
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Governed data behaviour proven against a real PostgreSQL platform
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence from behavioural verification against the real data platform

coverage.p0_finding: The composed production system must be verified, not only its parts
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Composed production system proven verified end to end in a real environment
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence from composition verification of the running system

coverage.p0_finding: The actual deployment path must be verified
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Actual deployment path proven verified in a real environment

coverage.p0_finding: Secrets and environment configuration must be consumed only by the actual entry points that require them
coverage.required_implementation_evidence: Secrets proven consumed only by the entry points that require them in a real environment
coverage.required_operational_proof: Operational evidence of scoped secret and configuration consumption
